{{Youmay|the algae|[[Glie'oleg Kru]] or [[Gobi Glie/Legends|Gobi Glie]]}}
'''Glie''' was a generic name used to describe two related [[Species/Legends|species]] of single-celled [[Algae/Legends|algae]] that grew in the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Whereas the [[red glie]] was used for handicrafts, [[Water/Legends|water]] purification and cooking, [[green glie]] was considered a dangerous hazard.
